entries.german: Sigmund fordert Ulrich v. Rosenberg u. Johann v. Malovic auf, die in ihrem Kreise gesammelte königl. Steuer baldmöglichst einzuschicken. Ad m. d. i. Johanne [de Kunwald] subcamarario referente.
entries.english: Sigmund asks Ulrich von Rosenberg and Johann von Malovic to send in as soon as possible the royal tax collected in their district. By order of the emperor: Johann [de Kunwald], reporting as subchamberlain.
